messages.text:
Sorry to hear that. Faulty units go through RMA: fill in the intake form and you'll get a return label, https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Before that, what's it doing, no power at all, or hashing wrong? Often it's the PSU, and we can send a PSU on its own without you shipping the miner back. Also, has it been overclocked at any point? Overclocked or modified units aren't covered.

The power supply, the brick and cable that plugs the miner into the wall. It's the part that fails most often, and it's easy to swap on its own.

So: when you plug it in, do any lights come on or fans spin at all, or is it completely dead?
Just to be sure, yes as in lights or fans do come on? Or yes as in it's completely dead?
